author: Jo
title: Looking for character artist/illustrator for indie game
content: Looking for a character artist / illustrator for my indie game. Please send links to your portfolio. This is would be a one-off paid contract. To be more specific, looking for serious character art, similar to Rimworld's illustrations:

author: Cut & Hire
title: HIRING: COMIC ARTIST for Sonic Shorts
content:
🚨 HIRING: COMIC ARTIST 🎨
